summary: Worker-4/6 source-reviewed rework reconciled linked database rows against primary Table 1, Methods, Table S1, OA package assets, and database snapshots; the prior framework-test ticket is closed with explicit cautions rather than accepted_clean.
adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source-reviewed rework closed rwk-complete-test-0001 by rebuilding the final activity table, replacing mechanism placeholders with source-bounded claims, and preserving DRAMP/dbAMP/database-sequence limitations as cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows and CAMP/dbAMP entry text were matched to the primary Table 1 peptide/organism/MIC matrix and article metadata; DRAMP no-MIC under-annotation and one dbAMP MammalianCells label are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence was rebuilt as the 12 organism by 6 peptide MIC matrix with source units, strains, media/incubation, and assay-method locators; no toxicity values were invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Automated placeholder mechanism notes were replaced by bounded activity, bacterial-binding, and immunodepletion/correlation claims with XML/figure/supplement locators; no ROS or pore mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_gate: The prior rework target is resolved; residual issues are caution-grade and explicitly recorded, so publication_grade is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

tools_attempted: review of pdftotext outputs for main PDF and Table S1

caution_findings.note: The primary article identifies Aβ1-40, Aβ1-42, rodent Aβ42, reverse Aβ42-1, and scrambled Aβ42 by name/residue range and assay column; full amino-acid strings are not embedded in local primary XML/PDF/supplement text, so database sequence strings were not promoted as primary-source sequence values.
DRAMP linked activity fields say no MICs/activity found, while primary Table 1 reports Aβ42 MIC values; final database audit preserves this as source_conflict.
The antimicrobial MIC list maps to the reverse Aβ42 Table 1 column, but the database MammalianCells label was not supported by local primary material.

caution_findings.record: supp:landing-*.bin plus OA package Table S1/Figure S1
caution_findings.note: file/rg inspection showed repeated HTML landing pages in landed supplementary bins; the real local OA package supplies Figure S1 and Table S1, and no separate spreadsheet changed activity/toxicity/mechanism evidence.
The worker-4/6 rework closes the framework-test blocker, but accepted_clean is not claimed because database/source caveats remain explicit.
